summary.text: WEBIUM AS is a private limited company registered in Svolvær, founded 2020-08-13. WEBIUM AS provides programming services within information technology, including IT consulting and the operation and development of digital solutions for itself and other companies. It was previously named WEBIN AS until 2021-01-14. Its main industry code is 62.100: computer programming activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 3 519 969 NOK and the annual result was 22 425 NOK; operating income was down from 4 304 911 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 78 885 NOK in 2024 to 22 425 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 950 416 NOK in 2024 to 972 841 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is webium.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn profiles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
